top_signals.title: BOE Rate Hike a ‘Big One and Done,” Says BNY’s Yu
top_signals.summary: “Probably it’s an insurance move,” says Geoffrey Yu, senior market strategist at BNY, as the Bank of England voted 8-1 to raise rates by a quarter point. He sees the messaging “not envisaging further moves” by the central bank’s Monetary Policy Committee. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Continue to Fall as Democratic Sweep Shakes Energy Markets
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices moved even lower, and energy company stocks followed after the results of the U.S. midterms, as markets brace for a potentially radical change in U.S. policies. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $94.30 per barrel, after dropping by 9% on Wednesday, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $87.35 per barrel, after shedding 8% on Wednesday, following the Democrats’ majority in both houses. top_signals.title: India to Require State Utilities to Add Energy Storage Capacity
top_signals.summary: India plans to soon mandate state-owned utilities to add energy storage capacity to take advantage of the clean energy boom with reduced waste of generated power amid lagging storage capacity, a senior official said on Thursday. India’s federal authorities will require the state utilities to add storage capacity, Pankaj Agarwal, secretary of the Indian Power Ministry, said at the ongoing Bharat Renewable Energy Summit.
